text:
nina: quick note from todays onboarding run: the new int4 candidate v3q2 passed bulk eval but we saw a transient anomaly in 'contracts' cohort where extractive spans were truncated. propose adding a span-fidelity metric to cohort checks and a per-cohort abort threshold.\n\nkevin: can you paste an example of truncation? was it due to kv-cache or max-tokens?\

nina: snippet: `User: paste contract, Bot: here is summary...` but summary cut off halfway through clause. logs show response token count lower than expected and stop_reason=api_eos.\
\nsara: important: contracts cohort is high-severity. let's set hard abort if span_fidelity_drop > 0.12 for that cohort. also record truncated samples to S3 for manual triage.\
\nli: technical note: span_fidelity should be computed as overlap F1 between golden spans and predicted spans -> use bootstrap CIs to avoid overreacting to small counts.\
\nml-eval-bot: v3q2 cohort metrics: contracts_span_fidelity=0.82 (baseline=0.95), span_fidelity_drop=0.13 (CI_lb=0.11), weighted_score=0.09 -> gate FAILED on contracts. artifacts: https://ci.redwood/ml-evals/1769012345/v3q2\

kevin: ok that's above proposed hard abort. what's fallback? soft-fallback to v2p1-int8 or immediate rollback?\

nina: for contracts we should immediate rollback. for other cohorts, we can try soft-fallback.\
sara: agreed. david (ops) should be paged for immediate rollback.\

infra-bot: rollback triggered by gate: revert to v2p1-int8. deploy 1769012500. (reaction :warning:)\

kevin: action: I'll add span_fidelity to gate config and ensure example snapshots are collection-labeled `contracts_truncation`. also will add a per-cohort min_samples check so tiny cohorts don't trigger aborts erroneously.\

li: will add bootstrap-with-min-n implementation to metric lib. recommend min_n=50 for span metrics.\

nina: thanks. follow-ups: we'll rerun eval on larger sample-set with beam/temperature control to see if decoding params matter.\

ml-eval-bot: archive: https://ci.redwood/ml-evals/1769012345/snapshot.tar.gz

sara: good catch. please post runbook note for contracts hard-abort threshold.
